status: Majority-lock gate evidence; binds the multi remaining-vote engine, first-count outcome helper, and scoped terminal runoff/IRV resolution
description: Publishes when every remaining-vote draw yields either a first-count majority winner or a scoped terminal resolution: a locked top-two runoff sample with wide uncertainty, first-preference IRV elimination transfers, or a two-candidate legislative-choice sample. Draws that cannot resolve stay unavailable.

historicalControls.note: Runoff sampling uses wide Dirichlet concentration 4 around first-count pair shares because first-round leaders lost two of three recent LA House runoffs. RCV uses noisy first-preference proportional transfers without cast-vote images.
